test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Identify the error in the given sentence and select the correct sentence from the given options.

Tide pool is a isolated pocket of water that is formed when sea water becomes trapped as tide goes out.

options.text: Tide pool is isolated pocket of water that is formed when sea water becomes trapped as a tide goes out.
A tide pool is an isolated pocket of water that is formed when sea water becomes trapped as the tide goes out.
A tide pool is a isolated pocket of water that is formed when sea water becomes trapped as a tide goes out.
The tide pool is isolated pocket of water that is formed when sea water becomes trapped as tide goes out.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the omission of the article "**a**" before the term "**isolated pocket of water**."
 
• Singular countable nouns typically require an article ("a" or "an").
 
• The correct phrase should be "**an isolated pocket of water**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• The article "**the**" should be used before "**tide**" to indicate a specific instance.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A tide pool is an isolated pocket of water that is formed when sea water becomes trapped as the tide goes out."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Tide pool is isolated pocket of water that is formed when sea water becomes trapped as a tide goes out."** – Missing articles "a" before "isolated pocket" and "the" before "tide".
 
• **Option 3: "A tide pool is a isolated pocket of water that is formed when sea water becomes trapped as a tide goes out."** – Incorrect article "a" should be "an" before "isolated pocket".
 
• **Option 4: "The tide pool is isolated pocket of water that is formed when sea water becomes trapped as tide goes out."** – Missing articles "a" before "isolated pocket" and "the" before "tide".
